The geometric_depth_auditor's depth map shows a reasonable spatial relationship, but the background people's distortion is evident. The Router's severity ratings are appropriate, but the HIGH artifact risk from the pose auditor suggests the background artifacts may be more severe than initially rated. I would increase the severity of the background artifacts to 4, as the fusion and distortion are significant and affect the overall image quality.
